sources.title: roprice / liver-us-nnunet-baselines Public - GitHub
sources.snippet: At full scale (625 training images), the model achieves 0.901 Dice on liver segmentation and 0.648 Dice on mass segmentation. Liver boundary detection is data-efficient, reaching 0.886 Dice with just 200 images. Mass detection never plateaus and remains data-hungry across all tested sizes, confirming it as the harder, clinically relevant challenge.
